title: Omni-MATH: A Universal Olympiad Level Mathematic Benchmark for Large Language Models
authors_zh: Bofei Gao 等（Peking University、University of Wisconsin - Madison、Alibaba Group、Shanghai Jiao Tong University 等）
paper_type_zh: arXiv preprint 的 benchmark / evaluation surface

one_line: Omni-MATH exposes olympiad-level math with subdomain and difficulty labels as an auditable evaluation surface.
Omni-MATH 把带子领域与难度标注的奥赛级数学题做成可审计的评测面。
why: Strong hard-math successor lead beyond MATH.
inclusion_reason: Strong hard-math successor lead beyond MATH.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Omni-MATH is an arXiv 2024 benchmark paper whose primary sources are the arXiv paper, project page, GitHub repository, Hugging Face dataset, and released Omni-Judge model. The problem is that MATH-style public benchmarks had become too easy for frontier models and too coarse for diagnosing olympiad-level mathematical reasoning, while live contest tasks and informal hard sets often lacked a stable public evaluation surface.

The card includes it as a benchmark/evaluation surface, not as a training recipe or a proof-producing formal system. A benchmark item is a competition-style math problem with a reference solution/answer, difficulty and subdomain metadata, and evaluation by either rule-based answer checking or the authors' Omni-Judge model. Its atlas value is the combination of hard-math item curation, category labels, and an explicit answer-level feedback contract that downstream evaluations can audit.

Omni-MATH 是 2024 年 arXiv 论文，主要一手来源包括 arXiv 论文、项目页、GitHub、Hugging Face 数据集和发布的 Omni-Judge。它针对的问题是：MATH 这类公开数学基准已经不足以区分前沿模型的奥赛级推理能力，而许多更难的竞赛题集又缺少稳定公开的评测对象和评分契约。

这张卡把它收为 benchmark / evaluation surface，不把它当训练配方，也不把它当形式化证明系统。一个样本是竞赛风格数学题，带参考解答/答案、难度和子领域标签；反馈由规则化答案检查或作者发布的 Omni-Judge 给出。对 atlas 的价值在于它把高难数学题、分类标签和可审计的 answer-level 反馈面放在同一个公开对象里。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The contribution is a universal olympiad-level math benchmark with fine-grained taxonomy, difficulty metadata, and an accompanying judge for answer evaluation. The core mechanism is not a new solver: the authors curate hard problems, organize them by mathematical subdomain and difficulty, evaluate models under controlled prompting, and release an evaluation-side judge to score free-form model answers.

The evaluation object is the problem-answer record plus its labels and scoring path. The feedback contract is answer-level: a submission is accepted or scored by rule-based matching where possible and by Omni-Judge for cases that need semantic equivalence judgment. Closest comparisons are MATH, GSM8K, OlympiadBench, and other hard-math benchmarks; Omni-MATH's direction signal is broader olympiad coverage and a more explicit hard-math evaluation contract.

核心贡献是一套覆盖更广的奥赛级数学基准，包含细粒度学科分类、难度信息，并配套发布用于答案评测的 Omni-Judge。它的新意不在提出求解器，而在把难题采集、分类、受控提示评测和答案判定工具组合成一个可复用的评测面。

数据对象是题目-答案记录及其标签和评分路径。反馈契约是 answer-level：能规则匹配的答案用规则检查，难以机械匹配的自由文本答案交给 Omni-Judge 判断语义等价或正确性。最近的参照物是 MATH、GSM8K、OlympiadBench 等数学基准；Omni-MATH 的方向标签是更难、更细分、更强调评测契约的 hard-math benchmark。

title: Method
方法
html:
Inputs are olympiad-level math problems, reference answers or worked solutions, subdomain labels, difficulty labels, model prompts, and model-generated answers. The paper treats the benchmark as evaluation-only; there is no single base model, optimizer, reward model training loop, or RL rollout recipe to reproduce.

Pipeline: 1. Curate hard math problems and normalize them into benchmark records with category and difficulty metadata. 2. Run evaluated models with a specified prompt/scaffold policy and collect final answers. 3. Score answers by rule-based checking where the answer format allows it, or by Omni-Judge where free-form equivalence must be judged. 4. Report aggregate accuracy by model, subdomain, and difficulty, while keeping item-level correctness as the decisive feedback unit.

Outputs are benchmark records, model-level scores, category/difficulty breakdowns, and a released judge artifact. Reuse requires pinning the dataset revision, judge revision, prompt template, answer extraction rules, model sampling settings, and whether a comparison used public examples, held-out examples, or a leaderboard snapshot.

输入包括奥赛级数学题、参考答案或解法、子领域标签、难度标签、模型提示和模型生成答案。论文中的 Omni-MATH 是评测对象，不是一个单一模型训练流程；不能从分数反推出 base model、optimizer、reward model 或 RL rollout 设置。

流程可以审计为四步：第一，整理高难数学题并归一化成带类别和难度元数据的 benchmark record。第二，用固定提示/脚手架策略运行待评测模型并抽取最终答案。第三，对格式明确的答案使用规则检查，对自由文本等价性问题使用 Omni-Judge。第四，按模型、子领域和难度报告 aggregate accuracy，但实例级是否正确仍是最终反馈单位。

输出是 benchmark 记录、模型分数、类别/难度拆分和发布的 judge artifact。复用时必须固定数据集 revision、judge revision、prompt 模板、答案抽取规则、采样设置，以及比较所用的是公开样本、保留样本还是某个排行榜快照。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper's evidence is primarily benchmark evidence: reported model accuracies on Omni-MATH, breakdowns by topic and difficulty, comparisons to earlier math benchmarks, and analysis showing that top models still leave substantial headroom on olympiad-level problems. The project page and Hugging Face release provide public artifacts rather than only paper-only claims.

The decisive row-level evidence is whether an individual model answer is accepted by the benchmark's scoring route: rule-based answer checking for mechanically comparable outputs, or Omni-Judge for semantic answer equivalence. Aggregate scores are not themselves reusable labels; they depend on answer extraction, prompt policy, model version, sampling budget, and judge version. Public release also creates contamination risk for later model evaluations.

论文证据主要是 benchmark 证据：作者报告了多个模型在 Omni-MATH 上的准确率、按主题和难度的拆分、与既有数学基准的比较，并显示前沿模型在奥赛级题目上仍有明显空间。项目页和 Hugging Face 发布提供了公开 artifact，因此结论不是只有论文表格可见。

真正的实例级证据是某个模型答案是否被该题的评分路径接受：可机械比较的输出走规则检查，语义等价难判断的输出走 Omni-Judge。aggregate score 不能直接当作单条样本标签复用；它受答案抽取、prompt 策略、模型版本、采样预算和 judge 版本影响。公开数据发布还会带来后续模型训练污染风险。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The prior baseline is the family of math reasoning benchmarks such as GSM8K, MATH, and OlympiadBench, where either difficulty, coverage, taxonomy, or answer judgment can be too limited for current frontier models. Omni-MATH changes the evaluation surface by emphasizing olympiad-level breadth, subdomain/difficulty structure, and a released answer judge for less mechanical responses.

The direction signal is a move from single-number hard-math accuracy toward audited topic-level and difficulty-level diagnosis. The quality signal is the presence of public paper, project, dataset, repository, and judge artifacts. What is not new: collecting math problems, reporting model accuracy, and using automated answer checking are established practices. Before reuse, inspect source licensing, dataset revision, split policy, judge failure modes, prompt leakage, and whether the target model has seen public Omni-MATH items.

既有基线是 GSM8K、MATH、OlympiadBench 等数学推理基准；它们在当前前沿模型面前可能出现难度不足、覆盖不够、分类不细或自由文本答案判定不稳的问题。Omni-MATH 改变的是评测面：强调奥赛级广覆盖、子领域/难度结构，以及可公开复核的答案 judge。

方向信号是从单一 hard-math accuracy 走向按主题和难度审计模型能力。质量信号是论文、项目页、数据集、仓库和 Omni-Judge 都有公开入口。并非新内容的是：收集数学题、报告模型准确率、用自动化答案检查，这些都已有先例。复用前要查 license、数据 revision、split 策略、judge 失效模式、prompt 泄漏，以及目标模型是否已经见过公开 Omni-MATH 题目。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Correctness holds only relative to the benchmark's reference answer and scoring path. A rule-based match can fail on mathematically equivalent but differently formatted answers; an LLM judge can accept or reject based on judge behavior rather than a formal proof. Omni-MATH should therefore not be read as a theorem-proving benchmark, a proof-step verifier, or a guarantee that a model's derivation is sound.

Reproducibility depends on dataset version, answer extraction, prompt wording, judge model revision, sampling budget, and model release date. Public HF/GitHub artifacts make inspection easier but also increase contamination risk. License and redistribution terms must be checked at artifact level before using records as training data, evaluation data, or reward-model supervision.

正确性只相对于 benchmark 的参考答案和评分路径成立。规则匹配可能拒绝数学等价但格式不同的答案；LLM judge 的接受/拒绝反映 judge 行为，不等于形式化证明。Omni-MATH 不能被误读为定理证明基准、proof-step verifier，或模型推导过程必然正确的证据。

复现受数据版本、答案抽取、prompt 文案、judge 模型 revision、采样预算和模型发布日期影响。公开 HF/GitHub artifact 方便审计，但也提高了训练污染风险。把记录用作训练数据、评测数据或 reward-model supervision 之前，必须逐 artifact 检查 license 和再分发条款。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Use Omni-MATH as a hard-math evaluation recipe and as a schema example for answer-level mathematical benchmarks. Preserve problem text, reference answer or solution, subdomain, difficulty, source/provenance, split or release revision, prompt template, answer extraction rule, scorer type, judge version, and per-item correctness.

For atlas work, it is most useful as a benchmark card for measuring post-training progress and contamination risk in olympiad-level reasoning. It is less useful as raw reward data unless the scoring route and license are audited separately.

可把 Omni-MATH 当作 hard-math evaluation recipe，也可把它的字段设计作为 answer-level 数学基准 schema 参考。复用时应保留题面、参考答案或解法、子领域、难度、来源 provenance、split/release revision、prompt 模板、答案抽取规则、scorer 类型、judge 版本和逐题正确性。

对 atlas 来说，它适合衡量后训练后模型在奥赛级推理上的进展和污染风险；若要把它当 reward 数据或训练监督，则必须另行审计评分路径和 license。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
Read the dataset construction and evaluation sections before comparing headline scores. Keep three claims separate: benchmark coverage, model accuracy, and judge reliability.

The most important boundary is that an accepted final answer is not the same as a verified derivation. Treat Omni-Judge decisions, rule-based matches, and aggregate leaderboard numbers as different evidence types.

阅读时先看数据构造和评测设置，再比较 headline score。要分开三类 claim：基准覆盖范围、模型准确率、judge 可靠性。

最关键边界是：最终答案被接受不等于推导过程被验证。Omni-Judge 判定、规则匹配和排行榜 aggregate number 是三种不同证据，不能混用。
